text:
```yaml
name: Update lint config

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1'  # Mondays at 00:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update-lint-config:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Update lint config
        run: make update-lint-config

      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update lint config from upstream"
          branch: update-lint-config
          title: "chore: update lint config from upstream"
          body: |
            This PR updates the lint configuration to the latest version from upstream.
          labels: "chore"
          delete-branch: true
```
